subject: Investigation into Personnel and Financial Allegations
overview: The Council convened to address documented allegations of legal and personnel misconduct but was barred from entering executive session due to a lack of prior notice to the affected individuals. The body voted to schedule a future session and formally requested independent legal and financial investigative resources.

items.title: Executive Session Procedure
items.summary: Solicitor Scanlon advised the Council that an executive session to discuss personnel allegations requires 48 hours' notice to the individuals involved. The Solicitor noted that affected individuals have the right to be present with counsel or request an open session.

items.title: Council Legal Representation
items.summary: Councilors expressed concern that the City Solicitor represents the administration and discussed the necessity of hiring independent legal counsel to represent the legislative body. Councilor Scarpelli questioned the validity of the budget process given the nature of the allegations.

items.title: Third-Party Investigation
items.summary: Solicitor Scanlon reported that the Mayor has already retained an outside investigator, Attorney Green, to conduct an impartial review of the matters. The Solicitor stated she could not comment on the specific scope of this investigation as it is an ongoing personnel matter.

items.title: Motion for Action and Rescheduling
items.summary: The Council voted to schedule a properly noticed executive session for Friday, June 25th. The motion also requested a mayoral appropriation for Council-specific legal counsel and an outside financial audit.

items.title: Public Testimony
items.summary: Mike Durham and Aleesha Nunley-Benjamin appeared to state they waived their rights to privacy and welcomed an open forum discussion. Solicitor Scanlon maintained that the Council must still wait 48 hours and provide formal notice to all named parties to avoid Open Meeting Law violations.

items.title: Investigation Scope Documentation
items.summary: Approved a motion to request copies of any written agreements, contracts, or memoranda defining the scope of the investigation initiated by the administration.
